mapper.select: SELECT ACCOUNT_NO AS account_no, MEMBER_NO AS member_no, ACCOUNT_NUMBER AS account_number, ACCOUNT_ALIAS AS account_alias, BALANCE AS balance, ACCOUNT_STATUS AS account_status, OPENED_AT AS opened_at, CLOSED_AT AS closed_at, UPDATED_AT AS updated_at FROM tb_account WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY OPENED_AT DESC
